title: Taking Flight

additional: Written in the Style of the Game Disco Elysium
Harry gets to go out and have fun wearing a dress

summary:
KIM KITSURAGI – Ever in tune with you, Kim notices your imperceptible reactions to the music. Your foot striking the floor beneath the table. The way you twirl the little cocktail umbrella between your fingers. How your eyes drift between him and the dance floor.
“Want to dance?” he asks.
DRAMA – You’ve thought about him saying those words since the night you ordered him to dance in the church on the Martinaise coast, when you were first enthralled by his moves. He obliges when you pull him close, radio blaring through your apartment, but you never imagined you’d hear him ask at a proper discotheque.
---
Kim takes Harry out for a night of dancing.
